  > Confirmed:
  > - REPRODUCE.md: Fig. 10 = figP6_interval.py and Fig. 11 = fig6_cluster.py match the built dev PDF (Figure 10 is the P6 interval, Figure 11 the cluster designs).
  > - Abstract and intro "5 of 13 cells": results/gnn_cells.csv, 13 cells, mechanism (d), log_ratio_vs_chin upper limit below 0 in 5 of 13 (7 of 13 by point estimate). Mechanisms a-c, e, f: 0 of 13.

True curvature at most 4.7. True-M coverage 0.91 and 0.59 for (b), (e). Threshold outside support: 0.998 of 27 cells.
  > 
  > One change needed (appendix.tex, P6 paragraph): "On the 666 cells of the block (nine groups: the null column and mechanisms (a)--(h)) ... (worst group, mechanism (e): 0.949) ... B1 0.963 (worst 0.882)". Two different populations are mixed:
  > - 0.990 / 8.4 and 0.963 / 3.3 and HC0 0.70 / 0.68 are means over the 666 cells of mechanisms (a)-(h) (p6_cells.csv, confirmatory, noise 0.5). The null column (33 cells) is not in the 666; with it there are 699 cells and the means are 0.991, 8.8, 0.964, 3.3.
  > - 0.949 and 0.882 are the worst group of the pass rule (p6_confirmatory_passrule.csv): 585 cells, threshold (d) excluded, nine groups = families HK and LN plus mechanisms a, b, c, e, f, g, h. Its means there are 0.990 (B2) and 0.967 (B1).
  > - On the 666 cells the worst mechanism is still (e), but with 0.935 (B2) and 0.853 (B1) (p6_confirmatory_tails_at_frozen_kappa.csv).
  > Suggested wording: "On the 666 cells of the block (mechanisms (a)-(h); the 33 null-column cells are reported separately) ... worst mechanism (e): 0.935 ... B1 0.963 (worst 0.853)"; and, if the pass-rule figures are wanted, "on the 585 smooth-or-linear cells of the pass rule (threshold excluded, nine groups: two families, seven mechanisms) the worst group is (e) at 0.949 (B2) and 0.882 (B1)".
  > 
  > Minor (results.tex): "7, 25, 110 at d=5, 20, 80". The tables give 7.0, 25.1, 108.6 for (a) and 7.0, 25.2, 108.9 for (f) (p6_confirmatory_mhat_diagnostics.csv), i.e. 7, 25, 109.
